t cacheName or cacheName == "" then
            return false, "no_cover_cache_name"
        end

        local coverPath = "YinYang_Cover_" .. cacheName
        local coverExists = false

        if isfile then
            local okFile, resultFile = pcall(function()
                return isfile(coverPath)
            end)
            coverExists = okFile and resultFile == true
        end

        if not coverExists then
            if not writefile then
                return false, "writefile_unavailable"
            end

            local okDownload, data = pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(track.CoverURL, true)
            end)

            if not okDownload or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 10 then
                warn("[YinYang Spotify] Falló la descarga de portada (" .. tostring(track.CoverURL) .. "): " .. tostring(data))
                return false, "download_failed"
            end

            local okWrite = pcall(function()
                writefile(coverPath, data)
            end)

            if not okWrite then
                warn("[YinYang Spotify] Falló writefile para la portada: " .. coverPath)
                return false, "cache_write_failed"
            end
        end

        if not getcustomasset then
            warn("[YinYang Spotify] getcustomasset no está disponible en este ejecutor; no se puede mostrar la portada: " .. coverPath)
            return false, "getcustomasset_unavailable"
        end

        local okAsset, resultAsset = pcall(function()
            return getcustomasset(coverPath)
        end)

        if not (okAsset and type(resultAsset) == "string") then
            warn("[YinYang Spotify] getcustomasset falló para la portada (" .. coverPath .. "): " .. tostring(resultAsset))
            return false, "getcustomasset_failed"
        end

        return true, resultAsset
    end

    local CoverAssetResolvedCache = {}

    resolveTrackCoverImage = function(track)
        if not track then
            return ""
        end

        if track.CoverURL and track.CoverURL ~= "" then
            local cacheKey = (track.CoverCacheName and track.CoverCacheName ~= "") and track.CoverCacheName or track.CoverURL
            local cached = CoverAssetResolvedCache[cacheKey]
            if cached then
                return cached
            end

            local okCover, coverAssetOrErr = ensureCoverCached(track)
            if okCover then
                CoverAssetResolvedCache[cacheKey] = coverAssetOrErr
                return coverAssetOrErr
            end
        end

        return track.Cover or ""
    end

    local function playTrack(index)
        local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not track then
            return
        end

        SpotifyState.SelectedIndex = index
        SpotifyState.CurrentTrack = track
        SpotifyState.CurrentTrackSeconds = durationToSeconds(track.Duration)
        SpotifyState.CurrentPause
dPosition = 0
        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true

        destroyAllSpotifySounds()
        destroyCurrentSound()

        updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, "Descargando y reproduciendo...")
        syncPlaybackUI()

        local okCache, cachedAssetOrErr = ensureTrackCached(track)
        local soundAsset = okCache and cachedAssetOrErr or track.AudioURL

        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "YY_Spotify_CurrentSound"
        sound.SoundId = soundAsset
        sound.Volume = SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume
        sound.PlaybackSpeed = SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed
        sound.Looped = SpotifyState.IsRepeat
        sound.Parent = workspace

        SpotifyState.CurrentSound = sound

        SpotifyState.SoundProgressConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if SpotifyState.CurrentSound == sound then
                updateProgress(track, sound)
            end
        end)

        SpotifyState.SoundEndedConnection = sound.Ended:Connect(function()
            if SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= sound then
                return
            end

            if SpotifyState.IsRepeat then
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        sound.TimePosition = 0
                        sound:Play()
                        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
                        syncPlaybackUI()
                    end)
                end)
                return
            end

            local nextIndex = index + 1
            if nextIndex > #SpotifyState.Catalog then
                nextIndex = 1
            end
            if SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor then
                nextIndex = SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor(index, 1) or nextIndex
            end
            playTrack(nextIndex)
        end)

        pcall(function()
            sound:Play()
        end)

        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
        updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, okCache and "Reproduciendo desde caché" or "Reproduciendo desde URL")
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function selectTrack(index)
        local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not track then
            return
        end

        SpotifyState.SelectedIndex = index
        SpotifyState.CurrentTrack = track
        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= nil and SpotifyState.IsPlaying or false
        updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, "Seleccionada: " .. track.Name)
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function toggleTrackLike(index)
        SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] = not isLiked(index)
        saveSpotifyFavorite(index)
        renderSongRows()
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function bindRowTap(guiObject, callback)
        if not guiObject then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            guiObject.Active = true
            guiObject.Selectable = false
        end)

        local lastFire = 0
        local function fireOnce()
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - lastFire < 0.35 then
                return
            end
            lastFire = now

            local ok, err = pcall(callback)
            if not ok then
                warn("[YinYang Spotify] Row tap failed: " .. tostring(err))
            end
        end

        if guiObject:IsA("GuiButton") then
            track(guiObject.Activated:Connect(fireOnce))
            track(guiObject.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fireOnce))
            track(guiObject.TouchTap:Connect(fireOnce))
            return
        end

        local activeInput = nil
        local startPosition = nil
        local moved = false
        local threshold = 14

        track(guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                activeInput = input
                startPosition = input.Position
                moved = false
            end
        end))

        track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if activeInput and input == activeInput and startPosition then
                local delta = input.Position - startPosition
                if delta.Magnitude > threshold then
                    moved = true
                end
            end
        end))

        track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if activeInput and input == activeInput then
                if not moved then
                    fireOnce()
                end
                activeInput = nil
                startPosition = nil
                moved = false
            end
        end))
    end

    local function applyPlaybackVolume(value)
        SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume = clamp(value, 0, 1)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then pcall(function() SpotifyState.CurrentSound.Volume = SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume end) end
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu(); refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end
    local function applyPlaybackSpeed(value)
        SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed = clamp(value, 0.50, 2)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then pcall(function() SpotifyState.CurrentSound.PlaybackSpeed = SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed end) end
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu(); refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end

        end

            task.defer(function() SpotifyState.BlockSwipe = false end)
        end
    end))

    PM.timerLeft = function()
        if not SpotifyState.SleepAt then return nil end
        return math.max(0, SpotifyState.SleepAt - os.clock())
    end
    for i, minutes in ipairs(PM.TIMERS) do
        local text = minutes == 0 and "No" or (minutes >= 60 and "1 h" or (tostring(minutes) .. "m"))
        local chip = PM.chip(PM.TimerRow, text)
        chip.LayoutOrder = i
        PM.timerChips[i] = {Button = chip, Value = minutes}
        bindRowTap(chip, function()
            SpotifyState.SleepMinutes = minutes
            SpotifyState.SleepAt = minutes > 0 and (os.clock() + minutes * 60) or nil
            refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu()
        end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while PM.Panel.Parent do
            local left = PM.timerLeft()
            if left then
                if left <= 0 then
                    SpotifyState.SleepAt = nil
                    SpotifyState.SleepMinutes = 0
                    if SpotifyState.CurrentSound and SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                        pcall(function()
                            SpotifyState.IsPlaying = false
                            SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = math.max(0, tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) or 0)
                            SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Pause()
                        end)
                        PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Pausado por el temporizador", "Paused by sleep timer")
                        syncPlaybackUI()
                    end
                end
                if PM.Panel.Visible then refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu() end
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    local FloatingPlayer = nil
    local FP = {mini = false, lastCover = nil, rotation = 0}
    local function previousTrack()
        if #SpotifyState.Catalog == 0 then return end
        local index = SpotifyState.SelectedIndex - 1
        if index < 1 then index = #SpotifyState.Catalog end
        if SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor then
            index = SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex, -1) or index
        end
        playTrack(index)
    end
    local function nextTrack()
        if #SpotifyState.Catalog == 0 then return end
        local index = SpotifyState.SelectedIndex + 1
        if index > #SpotifyState.Catalog then index = 1 end
        if SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor then
            index = SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex, 1) or index
        end
        playTrack(index)
    end
    local function togglePlayback()
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            if SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                SpotifyState.IsPlaying = false
                pcall(function()
                    SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = math.max(0, tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) or 0)
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Pause()
                end)
                PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Reproducción pausada", "Playback paused")
            else
                SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
                pcall(function()
                    if SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition and SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition > 0 then SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition = SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition end
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Play()
                end)
                PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Reproducción activa", "Playback active")
            end
            syncPlaybackUI()
        elseif SpotifyState.Catalog[SpotifyState.SelectedIndex] then
            playTrack(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        end
    end
    -- Barra compacta y navegación inspiradas en el reproductor móvil.

        N.cover = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = N.mini, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 28), BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = "", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 57,
        })
        corner(N.cover, 5)
        N.title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = N.mini, Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(51, 5),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = GetText("Selecciona una canción", "Select a song"),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = spotifyText, TextSize = 12,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 57,
        })
        N.artist = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = N.mini, Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(51, 24),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 210), TextSize = 10,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 57,
        })
        N.play = mk("ImageButton", {
            Parent = N.mini, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, -1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = asset(135609604299893), ImageColor3 = spotifyText, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 59,
        })
        N.progress = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = N.mini, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -2),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 58,
        })
        N.mini.Activated:Connect(function() SpotifyPages:JumpTo(PlayerPage) end)
        N.play.Activated:Connect(togglePlayback)

        N.nav = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = N.root, Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 36), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 53),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 56,
        })
        function N.button(index, icon, es, en)
            local button = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = N.nav, Size = UDim2.new(1/3, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new((index-1)/3, 0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = icon .. "  " .. GetText(es, en),
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = spotifyDim, TextSize = 11,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 57,
            })
            button:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", icon .. "  " .. es)
            button:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", icon .. "  " .. en)
            return button
        end
        N.home = N.button(1, "⌂", "Inicio", "Home")
        N.search = N.button(2, "⌕", "Buscar", "Search")
        N.library = N.button(3, "♫", "Mis canciones", "My songs")
        SpotifyState.RefreshCatalogNavigation = function()
            N.home.TextColor3 = not SpotifyState.MySongsView and spotifyText or spotifyDim
            N.search.TextColor3 = spotifyDim
            N.library.TextColor3 = SpotifyState.MySongsView and spotifyText or spotifyDim
        end
        function N.openView(mySongs, focus)
            if FavPage.hide then FavPage.hide() end
            if UserSongForm.Visible then closeUserSongForm() end
            SpotifyState.FavoritesView = false
            SpotifyState.MySongsView = mySongs
            SongSearchBox.Text = ""
            SongList.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            refreshSpotifyCatalogMode()
            if focus then pcall(function() SongSearchBox:CaptureFocus() end) end
        end
        N.home.Activated:Connect(function() N.openView(false, false) end)
        N.search.Activated:Connect(function() N.openView(false, true) end)
        N.library.Activated:Connect(function() N.openView(true, false) end)
        SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer = function(progress)
            if N.title.Text ~= PlayerSongTitle.Text then N.title.Text = PlayerSongTitle.Text end
            if N.artist.Text ~= PlayerSongArtist.Text then N.artist.Text = PlayerSongArtist.Text end
            if N.cover.Image ~= AlbumArt.Image then N.cover.Image = AlbumArt.Image end
            local icon = SpotifyState.CurrentSound and SpotifyState.IsPlaying and asset(74873705394436) or asset(135609604299893)
            if N.play.Image ~= icon then N.play.Image = icon end
            if progress then
                local p = math.floor(math.clamp(progress, 0, 1) * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000
                if p ~= N.lastProgress then N.lastProgress = p N.progress.Size = UDim2.new(p, 0, 0, 2) end
            end
        end
        SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer(0)
        SpotifyState.RefreshCatalogNavigation()
    end

    local function setFloatingVisible(visible)
        SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible = visible == true
        if FloatingPlayer then FloatingPlayer.Visible = SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible end
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu(); refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end

    FP.EXPANDED = Vector2.new(312, 112)
    FP.MINI = Vector2.new(48, 48)

    FP.iconButton = function(parent, image, size, iconSize, x, rotation)
        local button = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = parent,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 526,
        })
        corner(button, 999)
        local icon = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = button,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = image,
            ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            Rotation = rotation or 0,
            ZIndex = 527,
        })
        return button, icon
    end

    FP.applyMode = function()
        if not FloatingPlayer then return end
        local size = FP.mini and FP.MINI or FP.EXPANDED
        TweenService:Create(FloatingPlayer, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)}):Play()
        FP.Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, FP.mini and 24 or 18)
        FloatingPlayer.BackgroundTransparency = FP.mini and 1 or 0
        FP.Backdrop.Visible = not FP.mini
        FP.Shade.Visible = not FP.mini
        FP.Outline.Enabled = not FP.mini
        FP.Full.Visible = not FP.mini
        FP.Disc.Visible = FP.mini
        FP.Ring.Enabled = FP.mini
    end

    local function createFloatingPlayer()
        if FloatingPlayer and FloatingPlayer.Parent then return end
        FloatingPlayer = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(FP.EXPANDED.X, FP.EXPANDED.Y),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.floor(FP.EXPANDED.X / 2), 1, -(FP.EXPANDED.Y + 24)),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 16),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Visible = SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible,
            Active = true,
            ZIndex = 520,
        })
        FP.Corner = mk("UICorner", {Parent = FloatingPlayer, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)})
        FP.Outline = stroke(FloatingPlayer, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1, 0.86)
        FP.Ring = mk("UIStroke", {Parent = FloatingPlayer, Color = spotifyGreen, Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0.05, Enabled = false})

        FP.Backdrop = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = "",
            ImageTransparency = 0.62,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            ZIndex = 521,
        })
        mk("UICorner", {Parent = FP.Backdrop, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)})
        FP.Shade = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 522,
        })
        mk("UICorner", {Parent = FP.Shade, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)})
        mk("UIGradient", {
            Parent = FP.Shade,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.5),
            }),
        })

        FP.Drag = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 523,
        })

        FP.Full = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(FP.EXPANDED.X, FP.EXPANDED.Y),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 524,
        })
        FP.Cover = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 76),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = "",
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })
        corner(FP.Cover, 10)
        stroke(FP.Cover, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1, 0.8)
        FP.Fallback = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = FP.Cover,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "♪",
            TextColor3 = spotifyGreen,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 26,
            ZIndex = 526,
        })
        FP.Title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -164, 0, 18),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 12),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText("Selecciona una canción", "Select a song"),
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })
        FP.Artist = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -164, 0, 14),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 31),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "Spotify",
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })

        local controls = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 38),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 50),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })
        FP.LikeBtn, FP.LikeIcon = FP.iconButton(controls, asset(89748414415617), 32, 18, 0)
        FP.LikeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -16)
        local prevBtn = FP.iconButton(controls, asset(70466132711334), 34, 18, 38, 180)
        prevBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0.5, -17)
        FP.PlayBtn, FP.PlayIcon = FP.iconButton(controls, asset(135609604299893), 38, 16, 78)
        FP.PlayBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 78, 0.5, -19)
        FP.PlayBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        FP.PlayIcon.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        local nextBtn = FP.iconButton(controls, asset(124844823753990), 34, 18, 122)
        nextBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 122, 0.5, -17)

        FP.Time = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 14),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 62),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "0:00",
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })
        local barBack = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 4),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -12),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.75,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })
        corner(barBack, 999)
        FP.Bar = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = barBack,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 526,
        })
        corner(FP.Bar, 999)
        local seekHit = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -19),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 527,
        })

        local closeBtn = FP.iconButton(FP.Full, "", 24, 0, 0)
        closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 8)
        closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
        closeBtn.Text = "×"
        closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
        closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        closeBtn.TextSize = 15
        local miniBtn = FP.iconButton(FP.Full, "", 24, 0, 0)
        miniBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 8)
        miniBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
        miniBtn.Text = "–"
        miniBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
        miniBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        miniBtn.TextSize = 15

        FP.Disc = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = "",
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 524,
        })
        corner(FP.Disc, 999)
        FP.Ring.Parent = FP.Disc
        local hole = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FP.Disc,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 16),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })
        corner(hole, 999)

        bindRowTap(closeBtn, function() setFloatingVisible(false) end)
        bindRowTap(miniBtn, function()
            FP.mini = true
            FP.applyMode()
        end)
        bindRowTap(FP.LikeBtn, function()
            if SpotifyState.Catalog[SpotifyState.SelectedIndex] then toggleTrackLike(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex) end
        end)
        bindRowTap(prevBtn, previousTrack)
        bindRowTap(FP.PlayBtn, togglePlayback)
        bindRowTap(nextBtn, nextTrack)
        bindRowTap(seekHit, function()
            local sound = SpotifyState.CurrentSound
            local x = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation().X
            if FP.lastPointer then x = FP.lastPointer.X end
            if sound and sound.TimeLength and sound.TimeLength > 0 then
                local pct = clamp((x - barBack.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, barBack.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
                pcall(function()
                    sound.TimePosition = pct * sound.TimeLength
                    SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = sound.TimePosition
                end)
                refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
            end
        end)
        track(seekHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            FP.lastPointer = input.Position
        end))

        local dragInput, dragStart, startPos, moved = nil, nil, nil, false
        track(FP.Drag.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragInput, dragStart, startPos, moved = input, input.Position, FloatingPlayer.Position, false
                SpotifyState.BlockSwipe = true
            end
        end))
        track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragInput or not dragStart then return end
            if input ~= dragInput and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            if not moved and delta.Magnitude < 6 then return end
            moved = true
            local screen = Window.ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize
            local size = FloatingPlayer.AbsoluteSize
            local x = startPos.X.Offset + delta.X
            local y = startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            local baseX = startPos.X.Scale * screen.X
            local baseY = startPos.Y.Scale * screen.Y
            x = clamp(x, -baseX, screen.X - baseX - size.X)
            y = clamp(y, -baseY, screen.Y - baseY - size.Y)
            FloatingPlayer.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, x, startPos.Y.Scale, y)
        end))
        track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragInput then return end
            if input ~= dragInput and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
            if not moved and FP.mini then
                FP.mini = false
                FP.applyMode()
            end
            dragInput, dragStart, startPos, moved = nil, nil, nil, false
            task.defer(function() SpotifyState.BlockSwipe = false end)
        end))

        task.spawn(function()
            while FloatingPlayer and FloatingPlayer.Parent do
                if FP.mini and SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                    FP.rotation = (FP.rotation + 2) % 360
                    FP.Disc.Rotation = FP.rotation
                end
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
        end)

        FP.lastCover = nil
        FP.applyMode()
    end

    refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu = function()
        PM.Panel.Visible = SpotifyState.SettingsMenuVisible == true
        if not PM.Panel.Visible then return end
        local available = NowPlayingCard.AbsoluteSize.Y - 46
        local content = PM.BodyLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 24 + 49
        local cardW = NowPlayingCard.AbsoluteSize.X
        local width = (cardW > 0) and math.min(PM.WIDTH, cardW - 24) or PM.WIDTH
        PM.Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, math.floor(math.max(160, math.min(content, available > 0 and available or content))))
        local volume = SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume
        PM.VolumeValue.Text = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(volume * 100 + 0.5))
        PM.VolumeFill.Size = UDim2.new(volume, 0, 1, 0)
        PM.VolumeKnob.Position = UDim2.new(volume, 0, 0.5, 0)
        PM.SpeedValue.Text = string.format("%.2fx", SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed)
        for _, chip in ipairs(PM.chips) do
            PM.paintChip(chip.Button, math.abs(chip.Value - SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed) < 0.001)
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(PM.switches) do
            PM.paintSwitch(entry)
        end
        local left = PM.timerLeft()
        PM.TimerValue.Text = left and secondsToClock(left) or "Apagado"
        for _, chip in ipairs(PM.timerChips) do
            PM.paintChip(chip.Button, (SpotifyState.SleepMinutes or 0) == chip.Value and (chip.Value == 0 or left ~= nil))
        end
    end

    PM.switch(4, "Repetir canción", function() return SpotifyState.IsRepeat end, PM.setRepeat)
    PM.switch(5, "Aleatorio", function() return SpotifyState.Shuffle end, function(v)
        SpotifyState.Shuffle = v == true
        if SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged then pcall(SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged) end
    end)
    PM.switch(6, "Reproductor flotante", function() return SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible end, function(v)
        if v and (not FloatingPlayer or not FloatingPlayer.Parent) then createFloatingPlayer() end
        setFloatingVisible(v)
    end)

    refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer = function()
        if not FloatingPlayer or not FloatingPlayer.Parent then return end
        FloatingPlayer.Visible = SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible == true
        local currentTrack = SpotifyState.CurrentTrack or SpotifyState.Catalog[SpotifyState.SelectedIndex]
        if not currentTrack then return end
        local cover = resolveTrackCoverImage(currentTrack) or ""
        if cover ~= FP.lastCover then
            FP.lastCover = cover
            FP.Cover.Image = cover
            FP.Disc.Image = cover
            FP.Backdrop.Image = cover
            FP.Fallback.Visible = trim(cover) == ""
        end
        FP.Title.Text = currentTrack.Name or "Selecciona una canción"
        FP.Artist.Text = currentTrack.Artist or "Spotify"
        local current = SpotifyState.CurrentSound and math.max(0, tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) or 0) or 0
        local total = SpotifyState.CurrentSound and tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimeLength) or durationToSeconds(currentTrack.Duration)
        total = math.max(total or 0, 1)
        FP.Bar.Size = UDim2.new(clamp(current / total, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
        FP.Time.Text = secondsToClock(current) .. " / " .. (currentTrack.Duration or secondsToClock(total))
        FP.PlayIcon.Image = SpotifyState.IsPlaying and asset(74873705394436) or asset(135609604299893)
        local liked = isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        FP.LikeIcon.Image = asset(116559368303288)
        FP.LikeIcon.ImageColor3 = liked and spotifyGreen or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    local function openPlaybackMenu()
        SpotifyState.SettingsMenuVisible = true
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu()
        PM.Scale.Scale = 0.94
        TweenService:Create(PM.Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
        task.defer(refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu)
    end
    bindRowTap(SettingsClose, function() SpotifyState.SettingsMenuVisible = false; refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu() end)
    MoreTopBtn.Activated:Connect(openPlaybackMenu)
    MoreBtn.Activated:Connect(openPlaybackMenu)
    refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu()


    createFavoritesTile = function(layoutOrder)
        local m = getSpotifyMetrics()
        local cardH = m.compact and 228 or 242
        local coverPad = m.compact and 9 or 11
        local availableW = math.max(0, SongList.AbsoluteSize.X - ((m.gridColumns - 1) * m.gridGapX) - 8)
        local cellW = math.max(90, math.floor(availableW / m.gridColumns))
        local coverSize = math.max(76, cellW - 20)
        coverSize = math.floor(math.min(coverSize, m.compact and 138 or 182))

        local Card = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = SongList,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(coverSize + 20), cardH),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 38, 160),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = layoutOrder or 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 12,
        })
        Card.Name = "SpotifyFavoritesTile"
        corner(Card, 12)

        local Glow = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Card, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 90, 235), BackgroundTransparency = 0.72,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12,
        })
        corner(Glow, 12)

        local Heart = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Card, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(coverSize * 0.42), math.floor(coverSize * 0.42)),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.floor(coverSize * 0.21), 0, coverPad + math.floor(coverSize * 0.20)),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = asset(116559368303288),
            ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.
